summary: TULA's two medicated pieces are 2% salicylic acid, which a drugstore wash and CeraVe's leave-on gel match at the same strength; the cosmetic pore gel and clay mask are swapped for a 2% salicylic serum and a bentonite-kaolin mask.
evidence: The DailyMed kit label (NDC 84126-239-01) lists Keep It Clear Acne Foam Cleanser 1.69 fl oz/50 mL and Breakout Star Lightweight Acne Moisturizer 0.5 fl oz/15 mL with salicylic acid 2%, Clear Up Pore Clearing Gel 0.5 fl oz/15 mL as a cosmetic, and Detox in a Jar mask 0.49 oz/14 g; Ulta's kit page gives the same sizes and $49.00 price, and Target shows $49.00 with Drug Facts salicylic acid 2.0%. up&up Oil Free Acne Wash and CeraVe Acne Treatment Control Gel both list Drug Facts salicylic acid 2.0%; Minimalist's serum lists 2% salicylic acid; the Que Bella mask label lists bentonite and kaolin, as Ulta lists for the TULA mask.
differences: TULA's pieces use prebiotics, azelaic acid, tea tree and other extras that the rebuild lacks. The up&up wash is a liquid gel wash, not a foam. CeraVe's gel is sold as an acne treatment gel, not a moisturizer, though it is hydrating (glycerin, hyaluronic acid, ceramides). Minimalist's serum lists its 2% salicylic acid as a cosmetic ingredient, not a Drug Facts active, and adds glycolic and lactic acid; TULA's gel discloses no strength. The Que Bella mask is fragranced, has no lactic acid and is a single-use sachet. You buy full sizes ($33.77 up front for 8, 1 and 1.35 fl oz plus one mask) instead of travel minis.

extras: Target price $29.99; Dermstore and LovelySkin list the same kit at $39.99

up&up Deep Cleaning Pore Treatment (compare to Clean & Clear Deep Cleaning Toner), 8 fl oz
up&up PM Facial Moisturizing Lotion, 3 fl oz

summary: The two medicated steps of La Roche-Posay's Effaclar kit are 2% and 0.5% salicylic acid, the same drug actives and strengths as Target's up&up acne wash and pore toner; the matte moisturizer swaps for a ceramide + niacinamide lotion.
evidence: Target's kit listing gives Drug Facts salicylic acid 2% and 0.5%; Dermstore's kit page names 2% salicylic acid for the gel cleanser and LovelySkin/Dermstore confirm all three items are 3.4 fl oz. Target's standalone Effaclar Clarifying Solution Drug Facts show salicylic acid 0.5% (with glycolic acid as an inactive), and the Effaclar gel cleanser listing shows 2.0%. up&up Oil Free Acne Wash Drug Facts: salicylic acid 2.0%; up&up Deep Cleaning Pore Treatment Drug Facts: salicylic acid 0.5%. Toleriane Double Repair Matte ingredients (water, glycerin, silica, betaine, niacinamide, ... ceramide NP, sodium hyaluronate, perlite) were read on Target; up&up PM lotion lists niacinamide, three ceramides and sodium hyaluronate.
differences: The LRP toner adds glycolic acid and LHA is in the LRP cleanser; the up&up toner has neither and contains alcohol denat. and fragrance (the LRP toner also has alcohol denat.). The up&up PM lotion is a richer night-style lotion without the silica/perlite oil absorbers, so it is not mattifying; reviewers report a scent in newer bottles. You buy full 8 fl oz and 3 fl oz bottles instead of three 3.4 fl oz kit bottles. Kit price is Target's $29.99; elsewhere it is $39.99, which would make the swap even cheaper.

summary: Supergoop's four-mini set uses the same avobenzone/homosalate/octisalate/octocrylene filters (and a zinc/titanium mineral) found in e.l.f., CeraVe and up&up sunscreens, which cost far less per ounce in full sizes.
evidence: Ulta's set page lists sizes (three 0.5 oz minis and a 1 oz PLAY lotion) and per-item actives; Target's set page lists the same four products at $38. Target's standalone Supergoop pages confirm Unseen SPF 50 = avobenzone 3%, homosalate 7%, octisalate 5%, octocrylene 9% (isododecane/dimethicone base), PLAY Everyday SPF 50 = avobenzone 3%, homosalate 10%, octisalate 5%, octocrylene 7.5%, and Mineral Mattescreen = zinc oxide 17.68%, titanium dioxide 1.33%. Rebuild Drug Facts read on Target: e.l.f. Suntouchable Invisible SPF 35 = avobenzone 3/homosalate 7/octisalate 5/octocrylene 8 with an isododecane/dimethicone base (closest to Unseen); up&up Clear Face SPF 50 = avobenzone 3/homosalate 10/octisalate 5/octocrylene 10 (PLAY differs only in octocrylene 7.5%); e.l.f. Whoa Glow SPF 30 = avobenzone 3/homosalate 9/octisalate 5/octocrylene 7; CeraVe Invisible Mineral SPF 50 = zinc oxide 15.35%, titanium dioxide 2.66%.
differences: No component is an identical drug-facts match: filter percentages differ slightly and two swaps have a lower SPF (e.l.f. Invisible SPF 35 vs Unseen SPF 50; Whoa Glow SPF 30 vs Glowscreen SPF 40). Glowscreen's actives are listed differently across Target and Ulta pages (homosalate 0-7%, octocrylene 8-10%), so treat that line as approximate. Whoa Glow is a shimmer tint in three shades vs Glowscreen's Sunrise tint; CeraVe's mineral is a hydrating, not matte, finish; up&up Clear Face is a face lotion, PLAY is a body-and-face lotion. You buy four full-size products (about 8 fl oz total) instead of 2.5 fl oz of minis, so the upfront cost is higher (about $52) even though the per-ounce cost is far lower.

evidence: Ulta set page: $50 kit price ($59 value), balm 3.8 oz, remover 1.7 oz, soap 1.0 oz, in stock. summary: The Effaclar trio is a zinc foaming cleanser, an acid serum and a niacinamide gel-cream. CeraVe's oily-skin foaming cleanser plus The Ordinary's 2% salicylic acid and 10% niacinamide + zinc serums cover the same three jobs for about 60% less.
evidence: Set contents, sizes, price and key ingredients (zinc PCA in the cleanser; salicylic acid, glycolic acid, capryloyl salicylic acid and niacinamide in the serum; niacinamide, salicylic acid, LHA, zinc PCA in Duo+M) from the LOOKFANTASTIC set page. CeraVe Foaming Cleanser 473ml INCI (niacinamide, ceramides NP/AP/EOP, sodium hyaluronate) and £14.80 price from LOOKFANTASTIC. The Ordinary Salicylic Acid 2% Solution 30ml £6.10 and Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% 30ml £5.00, with full INCI, from theordinary.com/en-gb.
differences: La Roche-Posay does not publish percentages, so strengths cannot be matched. The Effaclar Ultra Concentrated Serum combines salicylic, glycolic and lipo-hydroxy acid with niacinamide; The Ordinary's serum is salicylic acid alone (2%), with no glycolic acid or LHA. Duo+M is a gel-cream moisturiser with salicylic acid, LHA, piroctone olamine and its Procerad/Phylobioma complex; The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% is a watery serum with no exfoliating acid, so you may still want a plain moisturiser on top. The Effaclar cleanser is a zinc PCA foaming gel; CeraVe's foaming cleanser has niacinamide and ceramides but no zinc. Three separate bottles instead of one boxed set, and the CeraVe cleanser is a bigger 473ml bottle (priced pro rata). LOOKFANTASTIC's £14.80 CeraVe price is 20% off its £18.50 RRP (site-wide SAVE20 offer); at RRP the rebuild is still about 55% cheaper.
